free_tier.stated: No free tier. NanoVPS-II 384 (Finland, AMD VPS Servers) is $2.49 per 6 months: 1 vCore, 384 MB RAM, 20GB NVMe, 1 IPv6/64 + 1 IPv4 NAT (20 Ports).

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a NAT VPS, not an object store

egress.terms: 2 TB guaranteed at 1 Gbps; after it is exceeded, fair use at 200 Mbps.

interface_detail: Root VPS image (Debian, Ubuntu, Alpine and Arch only).
chaining: A 2 TB NAT IPv4 box with a routed IPv6/64: IPv6 inbound needs no forwarded port; IPv4 inbound is limited to 20 forwarded ports and UDP forwarding is not stated.

limits.value: 2 TB guaranteed at 1 Gbps, then fair use at 200 Mbps
one NAT IPv4 with 20 ports; port speed 200 Mbps after the 2 TB

binding_note: 2 TB is the first number reached; past it the port is shaped to 200 Mbps rather than cut.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up terms require a valid, non-disposable phone number (prepaid mobile allowed) and accept only the user's own payment method; whether a card is the only payment route is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: The plan card prints 'No Backups and Non-Refundable'.
confidence_note: Plan, price and allowance are quoted from the vendor's front page read through a pinned provider; the sign-up terms give identity. The exact serverdeals listing (NanoVPS-384, Germany, USD 4.49 per year) was not found on the vendor's pages.

evidence.proved: the NanoVPS-II 384 plan is listed on the vendor's front page
the plan gets a routed IPv6 /64 and one NAT IPv4 with 20 ports
the plan guarantees 2 TB at 1 Gbps
past the 2 TB the port falls to a 200 Mbps fair use
the price printed beside the plan, per the 6 month term printed under it
